issues.evidence: Clear breast-shaped bulges visible through the fabric — the polish helped but the cup is still tracking body curvature. Real molded foam cup would be a smoother dome.
Fabric looks heavily crinkled / corrugated all over the torso. Real swim Lycra is smooth not foil-like. The wrinkle amplitude is way too high for a fitted one-piece.
FOE binding is barely visible at the V neckline. Real fold-over elastic at 1" reads as a clear 4 mm finished edge.
Cup edges still show some tessellation steps despite polish — boundary_snap could go higher.
The monstera leaf pattern reads as small vertical stripes rather than recognizable leaves. Larger motif scale would look more like the source reference.
Breast profile in side view is still visibly skin-conforming rather than a clean cup silhouette.
